questions.stem: How can a mixture be separated into its components?

options.text: Mixtures cannot be separated once formed
By physical methods such as filtration or distillation
Only by heating to very high temperatures

questions.explanation: Mixtures can be separated by physical methods such as filtration, distillation, and evaporation because the substances in a mixture are not chemically bonded together. Compounds, by contrast, require chemical reactions to separate.
